10.answer: The chairperson introduces the motion and recognises speakers. The secretary records the arguments. The timekeeper signals when each speech ends. A chief proposer introduces the case for the motion. A chief opposer challenges it. An adjudicator assesses the evidence and announces the decision.
10.explanation: For example, in a uniform debate the proposer could argue that uniforms reduce costs and the opposer could challenge that evidence. Give a distinct concrete duty for each role; local debate formats may use different titles.
